name: Eira Davies
bio:
Eira Davies hails from the heart of Wales, where her passion for engineering was ignited early by her grandfather, a retired mechanic. She spent countless hours in his workshop, dismantling and reassembling engines before she even reached her teens. Motorsport became her obsession after attending a local rally, and she knew she wanted to contribute her technical skills to the racing world. 

Eira is a highly competent machinist, known for her meticulous attention to detail and her ability to diagnose and solve complex mechanical problems. She thrives under pressure and is always looking for ways to improve the performance and reliability of the team's machinery. Her innovative approach and unwavering loyalty make her an invaluable asset to Sprint Masters.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Eira is of average height with a determined expression and a smudge of grease usually on her cheek.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas.
Has a habit of humming Welsh folk songs while working on intricate parts.
Insists on using a specific brand of lubricating oil.
